name: cc-connect
description: Bridges local coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeChat and other chat apps.

skills.name: Bridge Agents to Chat
skills.description: Connects local agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent and Gemini CLI to 13 chat platforms, including Slack and Telegram.

skills.name: Control from Chat
skills.description: Switches models, reasoning, permission modes, sessions and working directory with slash commands in the chat.

skills.name: Multi-Bot Relay
skills.description: Binds several agent bots in one group chat so they can talk to each other, such as Claude and Gemini side by side.

skills.name: Scheduled Tasks
skills.description: Sets up recurring agent jobs from natural language, such as summarizing GitHub trending every morning.

skills.name: Voice and Images
skills.description: Accepts voice messages and screenshots in chat, handling speech-to-text, text-to-speech and image forwarding to the agent.
